s1.description: The problem: many agents changing one codebase, and the change that rebases cleanly, compiles, and is wrong.

s2.description: The six parts of Premise, one at a time: agents and their Intents, forks, the ledger, premises, what happens when a premise breaks, re-derive, and the gate.

s3.description: What it shows: the case tests miss, the three-rule comparison, a larger run, and live runs anyone can start and replay.

s4.description: How it is built on Cloudflare, how it would scale up, where it would sit in a bigger system, the honest limits, and where to try it.
